reason: SSH-based cloud server management plugin providing remote terminal commands, file transfer, port tunneling, server configuration, system/GPU monitoring, environment management, and task queue access; human review is appropriate because it performs privileged remote operations.

summaries.zh: 通过 SSH 管理云服务器，支持远程命令执行、文件传输、端口隧道、服务器配置及系统和 GPU 监控。
summaries.en: Manage cloud servers over SSH with remote command execution, file transfer, port tunneling, server configuration, and system and GPU monitoring.

capabilities: Connects to remote servers over SSH
Uploads and downloads files via scp
Creates SSH port tunnels to expose remote services locally
Manages conda/Python environments and Slurm task queues
